source_boundary: Only metadata, tab names, and schema/header information are durable. Employee names, IDs, dates, health facts, case notes, supervisors, leave reasons, point values, and other row-level data are excluded.

trackers.name: FMLA Tracker
trackers.source_kind: Google Sheets native conversion plus legacy .xls
trackers.evidence: Google Drive metadata and schema-only review
historical_schema_evolution: Older annual tabs primarily tracked identity, hire date, leave-from/to, return-to-work, weeks/days/hours, insurance premium due, and leave-for.
Later tabs add received-in-HR, estimated begin/end dates, provider/certification and narrative workflow fields.
2026 tab adds explicit leave type, supervisor, general notes, return-to-work date, last-certified date, company-response status, and other-notes fields.
trackers.architectural_status: Current restricted case ledger is confirmed to exist. It should be modeled as an active case source, not inferred from email reminders.
issues: The workbook contains a long historical case archive mixed with current active cases.
Medical/case narratives and health-care-provider information make the tracker highly sensitive.
The legacy .xls and native Google Sheets copy may create duplicate-source ambiguity unless one is designated authoritative.
Policy rules must come from current handbook/legal authority, not from historical row annotations.
recommended_controls: Designate one authoritative live tracker/version and mark the other as migration/archive if appropriate.
Separate structured case status fields from free-text medical/case notes.
Link FMLA deadlines/forms to the current 2025 policy and current 2026 form library.
Do not commit row-level tracker content to GitHub.

trackers.name: Attendance Tracker
trackers.input_observation: INPUT identifies an ADP Employee Daily Totals Report with an April 2026 date range and an employee-effective-as-of date in May 2026.

other_tabs.purpose: restricted point-balance/point-event tracking; detailed row schema not promoted
list of supervisors/entities excluded from a check/process; identities not promoted

trackers.architectural_status: Current attendance workflow is confirmed and consumes ADP Employee Daily Totals data as upstream input.
issues: The tracker duplicates/derives data from ADP, so source/refresh lineage must be explicit.
Attendance, points, reserve time and FMLA intersect in one workbook, increasing risk of policy/case-data coupling.
Current handbook rules must govern point calculations and protected exclusions; spreadsheet formulas/legacy rows are not policy authority.
Supervisor exclusion/blacklist logic requires a documented business rule and owner.
recommended_controls: Treat ADP import as upstream source data with import timestamp/date range.
Formalize derived calculations and validate them against the 2025 handbook.
Separate FMLA/protected status from ordinary attendance consequences with restricted access.
Create deterministic reconciliation checks between imported totals and derived attendance records.
Preserve only schema/process metadata in GitHub.

cross_tracker_insight: FMLA and Attendance are both active 2026 restricted trackers. Attendance imports ADP totals and also tracks FMLA-related balances/status, while the FMLA Tracker maintains richer case/certification/return-to-work data. The integration boundary between them should be explicit to prevent duplicate case entry and inconsistent FMLA status.
